name: Hexagonal (Ports and Adapters) Architecture
forces_resolved: Complete isolation of core business logic from frameworks, UI, and databases
High testability via mockable ports (inbound and outbound interfaces)
Pluggable infrastructure adapters allowing database/UI swaps without business code changes
forces_unresolved: Indirection and mapping overhead between domain entities and DTOs
Does not inherently solve distributed horizontal scaling on its own
applicability_conditions: Domain-driven design (DDD) core applications with rich business rules
Long-lived enterprise software needing immunity against framework obsolescence
Systems requiring comprehensive unit and integration testing without database dependencies
anti_requisites: Simple CRUD-only applications where mapping layers add zero business value
Extreme high-throughput distributed message streaming as primary architecture
Sub-microsecond latency where port/adapter indirection is prohibitive
